blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Generally fair weather conditions are expected over Metro Manila and most parts of Luzon on Wednesday, Nov. 18, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Metro Manila and other parts of Luzon may experience hot and humid weather, with localized thunderstorms possible by Wednesday afternoon. “In other parts of Luzon, including Metro Manila, it will be hot and humid in the morning, though brief downpours caused by localized thunderstorms are still possible from the afternoon into the evening,” Pagasa weather specialist Leanne Loreto said.
